The best RPGs on PS Plus

RPGs are where PS Plus really earns its keep, with dozens worth a hundred hours of your life. These are our ten favourites right now, from huge open worlds where you make your own hero to tough action RPGs and deep tactical ones. Each one says what kind of RPG it is and roughly how long the main story takes. Looking for Persona or Final Fantasy? They're on our JRPG list. The full list of RPGs follows.

What counts as an RPG

In a role-playing game you play a character who grows as you go: you earn experience, pick skills and gear, and usually make choices that change how the story plays out. The genre ranges from huge open worlds you can lose a hundred hours in to tight, story-led adventures you can finish in a weekend.

This list counts Western-style RPGs and action RPGs. Japanese RPGs, with their own traditions of party-based battles and anime-inspired storytelling, have a list of their own. The full list includes every game on PS Plus tagged as an RPG.

1

Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

Realistic open-world RPG · PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 55 h main story

It's 1403, and Henry, a blacksmith's son caught up in a civil war, has to make his way across a lovingly recreated medieval Bohemia. There's no magic and no dragons, just sword fights that take real skill, a world that reacts to everything you do, and a story full of humour and heart.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Cyberpunk 2077

First-person open-world RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 86 · 66% recommend on OpenCritic · about 26 h main story

You're V, a mercenary in the neon-soaked megacity of Night City, with a dead rock star's ghost (Keanu Reeves) living in your head. It was overhauled after its rough launch and is now the game it was meant to be, full of brilliant side quests and choices that matter.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Bloodborne

Action RPG · PS4 · Metascore 92 · 98% recommend on OpenCritic · about 32 h main story

FromSoftware's gothic nightmare sends you through the plague-ridden city of Yharnam, hunting beasts that get stranger the deeper you go. The combat is fast and rewards aggression rather than hiding behind a shield. It's hard and makes no apologies, but few games feel this rewarding once it clicks.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Fallout 4

First-person open-world RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 87 · 88% recommend on OpenCritic · about 28 h main story

You emerge from a fallout shelter 200 years after the bombs, into the irradiated ruins of Boston, searching for your kidnapped son. Make your character, pick your side and lose yourself for weeks scavenging, building settlements and following strange side stories.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

First-person open-world RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 26 h main story

The dragons are back, and you're the only one who can stop them. Skyrim's real magic is the freedom to go anywhere and be anyone, from a thief to an archmage, and to lose hundreds of hours to side quests you never meant to start.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Horizon Forbidden West

Open-world action RPG · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 88 · 96% recommend on OpenCritic · about 29 h main story

Aloy heads west into the ruins of the American West Coast, where giant robotic animals roam overgrown cities and deserts. You build her skills and gear as you go, and taking down a towering machine piece by piece with a bow is one of the great sights in games.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition

Classic party RPG, turn-based or real-time · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 83 · about 56 h main story

A huge, old-school party RPG based on the Pathfinder tabletop game, where you lead a crusade against an invasion of demons and can grow into an angel, a lich or something stranger. You can fight in real time with pause or switch to turn-based, and the depth is enormous.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

Stealth and choice RPG · PS4 · Metascore 84 · about 16 h main story

Augmented agent Adam Jensen investigates a terrorist attack in a near-future Prague where people with cybernetic implants are treated as second-class citizens. Every problem has several answers, whether you sneak, hack, talk or fight your way through.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector

Narrative dice RPG · PS5 · Metascore 85 · about 9.7 h main story

A beautifully written sci-fi RPG played with dice: each day you roll to decide what you can do, as a runaway android and your crew scrape a living across a lawless asteroid belt. It's tense, humane and unlike anything else on the service.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

The Forgotten City

Mystery RPG with very little combat · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 85 · about 6 h main story

You're trapped in a time loop in an underground Roman city where, if anyone sins, everyone dies. Each loop you talk, investigate and use what you've learned to unpick the mystery. It began life as a Skyrim mod and became one of the cleverest stories on PS Plus.

Questions

What's the best RPG on PS Plus?

By Metascore, Bloodborne at 92, though it's very tough. For a sprawling adventure most people will love, Kingdom Come: Deliverance II and Cyberpunk 2077. For Persona and Final Fantasy, see our JRPG list.

What are the best RPGs where I make my own character?

Fallout 4, Skyrim, Cyberpunk 2077 and Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous all let you create your hero and shape who they become.

What's a good RPG for beginners?

Horizon Forbidden West and Skyrim are easy to get into, and The Forgotten City is short with almost no combat. Bloodborne is not a beginner's game.

Are there short RPGs on PS Plus?

Most RPGs are long, but Undertale takes about 7 hours and The Forgotten City about 6. Our short games list has more.

Are the classic Fallout and Elder Scrolls games on PS Plus?

Fallout 4 and Skyrim are in the Extra catalogue. The PS3 versions of Oblivion, Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas are listed for streaming with PS Plus Premium.

What's the difference between an RPG and a JRPG?

JRPGs are role-playing games from Japanese studios, or made in their style: usually a set hero and party, an anime look and a big story. The RPGs here tend to let you create your own character and roam more freely, or lean on tough action. Our JRPG list covers the other side.
